pr_title: gh-120225: fix crash in compiler on empty block at end of exception handler
pr_body:
Fixes #120225.

It's not necessary to set a line number here. It can be propagated later (and if it's not that's also ok, JUMP_NO_INTERRUPT doesn't require a line number).

issue_context.title: flowgraph.c: push_cold_blocks_to_end: Assertion `prev_instr' failed
issue_context.body:
# Bug report

### Bug description:

The following code causes a crash with cpython 3.13 (56a7e0483436d1ebd2af97c02defe0e67c4bb495) and with the current main branch (d68a22e7a68ae09f7db61d5a1a3bd9c0360cf3ee)

```python
async def name_4():
    match b'':
        case True:
            pass
        case name_5 if f'e':
            {name_3: name_4 async for name_2 in name_5}
        case []:
            pass
    [[]]
```

output (Python 3.13.0b2+):
```python
python: Python/flowgraph.c:2282: push_cold_blocks_to_end: Assertion `prev_instr' failed.
```
I bisected the problem down to this commit 2091fb2a85c1aa2d9b22c02736b07831bd875c2a.
@iritkatriel can you take a look at it?



### CPython versions tested on:

3.13, CPython main branch

### Operating systems tested on:

_No response_
